tool_analysis: Step Analysis: The recorded session navigated Magento admin attribute grid, logged in, applied filters, opened New Attribute, and attempted to find the per-row Edit link for attribute 'color' but static snapshots lacked anchor hrefs. The tool will reproduce these actions deterministically and include runtime JS/XPath fallbacks to locate the edit anchor and extract edit page controls.Task Definition: A parameterized automation that: 1) navigates to Manage Attributes grid, 2) fills filters (attribute_code, frontend_label, scope), 3) applies Search, 4) optionally clicks Add New Attribute, 5) locates and opens attribute edit for the given attribute_code using robust XPath and JS fallback, 6) extracts Save/Back/attribute_code/is_global/frontend_input selectors and values.Action Plan: - Navigate to provided grid URL - Wait for grid - Fill attribute_code input - Fill frontend_label input if provided - Set scope select if provided - Click Search - Wait for grid reload - Locate edit anchor via XPath by matching row cell text, prefer anchors with '/edit' or 'attribute_id' in href. - If anchor found, click it (or fetch href and parse edit page HTML to avoid navigation) - After navigation or fetch, extract controls and return selectors/valuesVariable Identification: Inputs: attribute_code (required), frontend_label (optional), scope_value (optional), click_add_new (optional boolean), base_url (required)Step Optimization: Use direct navigation to URL and name/id-based selectors when present; use observed element hashes for stable interactions; provide JS fallback snippet to run in live browser to find anchors when static snapshots lack hrefs. Ensure the agent does not attempt to guess IDs/hrefs; instead it reads at runtime. Deterministic steps and minimal actions included.
name: magento_attribute_tool
description: Automate common interactions on Magento 1 Manage Attributes page: filter attributes, open Add New Attribute, open attribute edit by code, and extract edit page controls. Uses robust XPaths/selectors and provides runtime JS fallbacks when anchors are not present in static snapshots.

steps.description: Navigate to Manage Attributes grid URL.
Wait for page to load and grid to appear.
Fill the Attribute Code filter input with the provided attribute_code. Uses observed element hash from the session.
Fill the Attribute Label filter input with the provided frontend_label. Uses observed element hash from the session.
Select Scope filter option matching visible text (Store View / Website / Global). Uses observed element hash.
Click the Search button to apply filters (uses observed element hash for Search).
Wait for grid to refresh after applying filters.
Use runtime DOM operations when static anchor href is not present; limited to 8 steps.
steps.task: Locate and open edit link for attribute_code '{attribute_code}' using XPath //table//tr[td[1][normalize-space()='{attribute_code}']]//a[contains(@href,'/edit') or contains(@href,'attribute_id')][1]. Try anchor.click(); if not present, fetch href and parse edit page HTML. If click occurs, after navigation extract Save/Back/attribute_code/is_global/frontend_input.

steps.description: Extract key controls from the attribute edit page to confirm selectors and current values.
steps.goal: After navigation to edit page, extract Save/Back buttons and fields attribute_code, is_global, frontend_input and return selectors/values.

input_schema.name: attribute_code
input_schema.description: Exact attribute code to filter and open (e.g. 'color')

input_schema.name: frontend_label
input_schema.description: Attribute frontend label to filter by (e.g. 'Color')

input_schema.name: scope_value
input_schema.description: Scope filter visible text: 'Store View', 'Website', or 'Global' - tool will select by visible text

input_schema.name: click_add_new
input_schema.description: If true, click the Add New Attribute button before other actions
